name: Recital B
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: B. whereas the current MFF quickly proved its inadequacy in terms of responding appropriately to certain crises and new political challenges that were not and could not have been anticipated at the time of its adoption; whereas, for the purpose of securing the necessary funding, the MFF was pushed to its limits including an unprecedented recourse to the flexibility provisions and special instruments, which has revealed serious shortcomings as regards design, transparency and evaluation; whereas the European Court of Auditors stressed, in its special report 18/2025, that the Commission had failed to carry out an ex ante or retrospective evaluation of the functioning of the margins, the Flexibility Instrument or the Emergency Aid Reserve, making it impossible to gauge the real effectiveness of these tools or to draw lessons from them for the future; whereas this failure to carry out evaluations runs counter to the principles of effective risk management and evidence-based policymaking; whereas these tools are not meant to be used as substitutes for sound long-term budgetary planning; whereas this led to programmes such as cohesion policy being repeatedly used to respond to emergencies, thereby making it difficult to achieve their initial long-term objectives;
